support-ops: hey @alex — customer (tenant=acme-inc) is getting a 400 on a tool_call after a handle rename. They called `DataFetcher` (mixedCase) and got schema validation errors. snippet:
```
POST /v1/tool/call
{
  "tool": "DataFetcher",
  "args": { "userID": "1234" }
}
Response 400:
{"error":"schema_validation_failed", "detail": "unexpected arg 'userID' for tool datafetcher v2" }
```
support-ops: request_id=req_01HabcdXY; logs show it matched an unexpected legacy handle before invoking runtime pool-02.

alex: hmm. sounds like casefold/alias resolution routed to a legacy handle that expects snake_case `user_id`

support-ops: here's the router log line we have:
`[2024-09-03T15:12:01Z] router#lookup tenant=acme name="DataFetcher" -> matched handle="acme:datafetcher:legacy" alias_ttl_expired=false route=pool-02`

alex: alias_ttl_expired=false but still matched legacy. could be registry->router propagation lag or ambiguous tenant-prefix matching letting fallback win. did the customer recently hit a rename?

support-ops: yes, they renamed `DataFetcher` -> `datafetcher` two hours before the error. We saw registry entries: new canonical `datafetcher:v3` + legacy alias pointing to v2. Some routers still have the old alias mapping.

tj: quick repro for infra: call with exact UUID header to bypass alias resolution: `X-Tool-UUID: urn:tool:acme:datafetcher:v3` — that should route to v3 and accept `userID` or we can normalize args to `user_id` depending on schema. also try lowercasing the tool name (`datafetcher`) as a customer workaround.

eng-bot: note: registry-resync job last run: 2024-09-03T14:00:00Z on region-us-east-1. router-cache-ttl is 5m (config: routing.cache.ttl=300s). There was a manual tune last week in dev which temporarily lowered propagation frequency to 1m in canary — double-check that canary didn't roll to prod.

alex: action plan: (1) run on-demand registry resync for tenant=acme across routers in us-east-1 (2) invalidate router caches for pool-02 (3) ask customer to call with UUID or lowercase name as workaround, include repro snippet and expected schema keys. I'll open infra ticket and ping ops.

support-ops: copying proposed customer text: 
"We're investigating. Temporary workaround: call the tool using the UUID header `X-Tool-UUID: urn:tool:acme:datafetcher:v3` or use `tool: \"datafetcher\"` (all-lowercase). We're running a registry resync and will update when caches are invalidated."

alex: sounds good. also add a follow-up to check alias tombstone handling — we shouldn't route to legacy if canonical exists and alias points forward.

support-ops: thanks. I'll update the customer and mark P1 until resync completes. :thumbsup:
